slug: 2022-04-28 Interoperability of CRVS and EIR systems for improved EPI management in Rwanda

systems.system: DHIS2 national routine Health Management Information System
systems.tiers: national since 2012; holds aggregate and individual-level (Tracker) data, with monthly aggregate reports

systems.owner: national EPI Program, supported by HISP Rwanda
systems.tiers: all public and private health facilities offering routine vaccination, rolled out from 2019, with training down to cell level

systems.owner: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda with the Ministry of Local Government, the Ministry of Health and NIDA
systems.tiers: births registered at the health facility; launched 2020

systems.platform: custom script pushing registered newborns from CRVS to the DHIS2 EIR Tracker
systems.owner: health authorities, supported by HISP Rwanda
systems.tiers: configuration complete and validated as of April 2022

note: DHIS2 impact story of April 2022 on the immunisation registry (a tracker) and its link to civil registration; of the HMIS it says only that DHIS2 has been the national routine system since 2012, with no statement on tiers, where data is keyed, ownership or clinic counts.
